speaker: john_heminges
text: Will? John Heminges. From Aldermanbury, with the book open.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: John. I am at the Theatre. The book, then.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Yesterday's boxes were the best since Whitsun. Bankside has found the way to Shoreditch while the Rose is dark. Saturday's share will be seventeen shillings, or near it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Seventeen, or near it. That is Saturday's figure. What is the matter?

speaker: john_heminges
text: Item, August. Four weeks dark, and five hired men who'll eat whether we play or no. If I pay them nothing, the— the Admiral's will have two of them by Bartholomew.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Five shillings a week each, out of the stock, to hold them. Five pound for the month.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Pay it. A hired man who knows his cues is cheaper than a new one.

speaker: john_heminges
text: And the Labour's Won, for Michaelmas?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: On the thirty-first of April, John. You shall have a king at Michaelmas, cut to the Master's measure.

speaker: john_heminges
text: My knees are bad in the heat. My wife says Nick has had new shoes twice since Easter.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twice since Easter is a boy's feet. I have heard it.
